items.title: File Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid
items.quote: Dafür steht ein Zeitraum von zwei Wochen ab Zustellung zur Verfügung, der sich nicht verlängern lässt.
items.computation: The letter itself states the exact service date: 'Durch die Post zugestellt am Montag, 23.11.2026.' This is a formal court service (Zustellung), so the statutory 4-day deemed-delivery rule for ordinary administrative post does not apply — the stated date is used directly. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (23.11.2026) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 339 Abs. 1, § 700 Abs. 1 ZPO) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the second week bearing the same name as the delivery day, i.e. Monday 07.12.2026. That day is a normal business day in Schleswig-Holstein (no shift needed under § 222 ZPO). This is a Notfrist and cannot be extended.

items.title: Total amount tituliert as owed (already enforceable)
items.computation: The Vollstreckungsbescheid declares the claim enforceable immediately because no Widerspruch was filed against the earlier Mahnbescheid; it does not print a new payment deadline. The underlying Leasingraten were already overdue (August/September 2026). No explicit 'pay by' sentence is given in the letter, so no new exact due date can be computed; the amount is already collectible by enforcement at any time, which is why getting advice before 07.12.2026 (the Einspruch deadline) matters.

warnings: This is a Vollstreckungsbescheid (enforcement order) following an unanswered Mahnbescheid: the two-week Einspruch deadline (07.12.2026) is a non-extendable Notfrist, and the creditor can start enforcement (Zwangsvollstreckung) once it passes — get legal advice promptly if the claim is disputed.

No explicit new payment due-date is printed for the EUR 748,71 total; verify with the court or a lawyer whether partial amounts (e.g. the original leasing instalments) were already overdue before relying on any specific payment date.
